bio: Pia Dandiya (born 1987) is an American educator, former technology executive, and politician who is the United States representative-elect from Florida's 22nd congressional district. A former high school principal and White House Fellow, she later led public-sector initiatives at Apple Inc. She was the Democratic nominee for Florida's 22nd congressional district in the 2026 election, defeating Republican nominee Casey Askar.
